title: Employer/character slot renderers (AsStatedText/AsStatedAmount/ShortTextPair) never executed by any test — 2 of 3 slots' question rendering unpinned
detail: form_pages_test renders LandlordRef questions only; integration seeds landlord_ref only. A renderer field-name drift (a_salary_confirmed_choice, a_relationship, a_capacity) would silently break employer/character submissions — the validator contract is pinned only in questions_test.
recommended_fix: Add render pins for EmployerRef (8) and CharacterRef (5) sets: assert a_<id>_choice/_text/_amount field names, a_relationship/a_capacity, and the AsStatedText open-variant branch (text field only).

title: Landlord compound controls render but their distinctive fields are never asserted
evidence: Renderer (line 216): "attribute.value(prefill_value(qv.prefill, "a_tenancy_from"))," with "attribute("data-testid", "reference-input-tenancy_from")," — but the only form-page pins are: "string.contains(page, "name=\"_website\"") |> should.be_true", "string.contains(page, "Question 4 of 11") |> should.be_true", "data-testid=\"reference-option-tenancy_confirmed-yes\"" — no reference-input-* assertion exists in form_pages_test.gleam
detail: MonthYearOrOngoing, AmountOrDontRemember and ChoiceWithOther render in the landlord set, yet no assertion touches their controls (month inputs, amount, dont_remember, other text); pins pass even if a branch drops its fields.
recommended_fix: Assert reference-input-tenancy_from/tenancy_to/tenancy_ongoing, reference-input-rent_amount, reference-input-dont_remember and the _other text field testids in the form-page render pin.

title: Resume pre-fill wiring (checked/value from draft) never asserted — resume test pins only the data-current marker
evidence: Unit pin passes an empty draft: "prefill: dict.new()," (form_pages_test.gleam:97). Resume integration assertion is marker-only: "string.contains(body, "data-current=\"true\" data-question=\"relationship\"")" (line 213). The wiring under test is: "attribute.checked(current == opt.0)," (line 367) and "attribute.value(prefill_value(qv.prefill, field))," (line 397)
detail: AC3/AC4 pre-fill on resume; the render-side wiring of saved drafts into checked/value is untested, so a resume that renders stale or empty values would pass CI.
recommended_fix: Extend the resume integration test (or a render pin) with a pre-filled choice and a text question, asserting attribute.checked and attribute.value.

title: Navigation render pins missing: Start href (?q=<first>#q-<first>) and Back link (back_url branch) unasserted
evidence:
Landing pin only checks the testid: "string.contains(page, "data-testid=\"reference-start\"") |> should.be_true" (form_pages_test.gleam:54) — not the href built at form_pages.gleam:131 "<> "?q="". Back branch (form_question_pages.gleam:158-163): "Some(url) ->
            html.a(
              [
                attribute.href(url),
                attribute.class("ref-back-link"),
                attribute("data-testid", "reference-back")," — grep for "reference-back" in server/test/ returns nothing
detail: The Start href is the only no-JS path from landing into questions, and the Back link the only no-JS way back; neither href nor testid is asserted anywhere.
recommended_fix: Pin the landing start href (contains ?q=identity#q-identity) and assert data-testid="reference-back" renders for non-first questions.

title: js_saved_indicator ↔ reference_form.js SAVED_TEXT sync contract has no cross-file pin
detail: The documented KEEP IN SYNC contract between the Gleam constant and the JS literal has no cross-file test; a one-sided copy change would ship silently.
recommended_fix: Add a node --test pin (or Makefile check) that reads reference_form.js and asserts the js_saved_indicator value appears verbatim.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: Verified suite run: "1371 passed, no failures, 432 skipped" (gleam test, server) and "# pass 118" (node --test scripts/js-tests/*.test.js). P0 flows integration-pinned: landing/form_opened_at stamp, no-JS answer POST + PRG, validation rerender, unknown 404, terminal pages, resend rollback, takeover, honeypot/timing silent-drop. Renderer gap: "let slot = LandlordRef" (form_pages_test.gleam:90) is the only slot rendered; AsStatedText/AsStatedAmount/ShortTextPair branches (form_question_pages.gleam:256,288,302) never executed
detail: P0 100% (landing, no-JS answer flow, state pages, resend, abuse all integration-pinned); P1 80-89% (question-renderer surface: 3 control kinds + prefill + back links unexecuted/unasserted); overall >=80%. Tests are real, not tautological.
recommended_fix: Add employer/character render pins, compound-control and prefill assertions, and nav-link pins (findings above); the gate then passes.
